Treating the IRA as your own means withdrawals before 59½ usually carry the 10% additional tax; as a beneficiary they don’t. You can stay a beneficiary for now and treat the IRA as your own later. The spousal election follows proposed IRS regulations (REG-103529-23) that are not yet final, so confirm with your IRA custodian how it applies.
